title: رودري: ريال مدريد لا يخدعني كما يفعل بالمنافسين
summary: الدولي الإسباني حذر من قوة الميرينجي

title: Drake Turns 40, Shares Personal Childhood Photos: ‘I Accept You for You’
summary: A flip through home photo albums and a duet with the Backstreet Boys marked Drake's 40th birthday.
body: Drake is 40 years old. For his Oct. 24 birthday, he paid tribute to his younger self on social media with a sweet, personal glimpse at who he was as a kid. “I accept you for you,” he wrote to himself on Instagram. There, he posted childhood pictures of himself on the eve before turning 40. In one snapshot, he’s seen sitting on the hood of a car hugging his copy of the book My Teacher Fried My Brains . One-upping most 40th birthday parties, Drake entered his 40s by sharing the stage with the Backstreet Boys to feature on one of his all-time favorite pop hits, “I Want It That Way.” The “I Want It That Way” superfan basked in the joy of the stepping in as a bonus Backstreet Boy Friday night (Oct. 23), unabashedly joining on vocals throughout the 1999 single, one of BSB’s top five hits; the track peaked at No. 6 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart that year, and was inescapable on Top 40 radio and MTV’s TRL countdown. title: YouTube streams may look better and buffer less as soon as early 2027
summary: AV2 is coming to YouTube in the not too distant future.
body: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR YouTube has announced that it plans to roll out AV2 to the platform in early 2027. The AV2 codec will initially launch for the web version of YouTube. The company also hints at benefits for multi-view experiences. Earlier this year, the Alliance for Open Media released the definitive specs for the AV2 codec , which is expected to be about 25% to 32% more efficient than AV1. That means you get higher-quality streaming for the same bitrate or comparable quality at a lower bitrate. The benefit is that the codec can reduce the amount of bandwidth you’re consuming. YouTube is expected to adopt AV2, and it could arrive sooner than you would expect. While partners like Netflix, Amazon, and Apple have been quiet on rollout plans, it appears that YouTube isn’t quite as shy. According to FlatpanelsHD , YouTube has revealed that it is looking to roll out the codec in early 2027. The plan is to initially launch AV2 for the web version of the platform.

title: You can now manage Gemini Notebooks directly from your Gemini chats
summary: Now you can access your notebooks from your Gemini chat.
body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Gemini Notebook is now available as a Connected App in the Gemini app. This integration allows you to manage and query notebooks from your conversation with Gemini. The Gemini Notebook Connected App is available to all Workspace customers, Workspace Individual subscribers, and users with personal Google accounts. If you want to make the Gemini app more useful, you could start using Connected Apps. These are apps that can be integrated with the chatbot, allowing you to access their services without leaving your Gemini conversation. Recently , Peloton, SeatGeek, Airtable, and others have become Connected Apps, but Google is far from done. Another useful app just joined the Connected App collection. The helpful learning tool Gemini Notebook, formerly NotebookLM, is now a Connected App. That means you’ll now be able to manage and query notebooks within your chats with Gemini. All you have to do is type @Gemini Notebook into chat, and you can start creating new notebooks, adding sources, saving notes, and accessing information from an existing notebook.
